edges.description: Continuum current-state documentation explains the active lifecycle gates and must be read with machine state and exact owner decision artifacts.
project-state.json carries deterministic Pilot/evidence flags, including the fail-closed distinction between readiness and authorization.
The OD-PILOT-01 owner packet defines prerequisites and current non-adoption boundaries; its existence does not authorize a Pilot.
STATUS.md provides a readable Continuum explanation while deferring gated lifecycle truth to machine state, owner decisions, and live repository evidence.
The owner decision packet explains what would be required to change Pilot state; machine state records the current authorization flag and cannot substitute for owner GO.
CLOS current status is the first route for deciding which research frontier is live, closed at evidence ceiling, or only a reopen condition.
CLOS_BLUEPRINT.md frames substrate-neutral cognitive functions and distinctions without selecting an LLM/runtime implementation.
The CLOS evidence ledger is the route for research support, limitations, contradictions, and unresolved questions; it is evidence tracking, not truth authority.
Discriminating fixtures test competing cognitive explanations before any proposal for a new primitive or implementation is justified.
CASE E records that history-dependent cognitive availability is supported while the underlying mechanism remains underdetermined and no new primitive is authorized.
Cognitive OS is the replaceable LLM-oriented implementation/research profile; CLOS blueprint is the substrate-neutral research layer, so implementation choices do not become cognitive law.
The multi-AI trace preserves discussion history around understanding and experience that informs CLOS research but does not itself promote a CLOS conclusion.
The cognitive research trace overlaps Soul questions about cognition and identity, while Soul remains the owning semantic domain for its internal mechanisms.
